title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2611.23142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. translated_title: 注意差距：一个用于文档维护的已部署多智能体系统
translated_abstract: “AI革命”使科技行业的各团队能够以前所未有的速度交付软件功能。然而，当代码以比以往更快的速度演进时，面向客户的文档却常常难以跟上步伐。随着用户越来越依赖以文档作为主要交互接口的基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体，这种文档差距的影响日益加剧：过时的信息会被传播并被当作权威信息对待。用于识别文档滞后于代码的信号其实早已大量存在，既有显性信号（例如，已解决的客服工单能够揭示文档缺失之处），也有隐性信号（例如，可通过自动化循环检测出的代码与文档之间的不一致）。我们部署了一个多智能体系统，其核心是我们称之为"TriAgent"的分诊智能体，该系统持续提取这些信号并修复文档漂移。在43天的影子模式运行中，我们的系统对499个工单进行了分诊，并发现了92个文档差距。
tldr: 该论文提出并实际部署了一个以"TriAgent"分诊智能体为核心的多智能体系统，通过持续挖掘客服工单和代码-文档不一致等显性与隐性信号，自动检测并修复客户文档与技术实现之间的漂移。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a deployed multi-agent system centered on a "TriAgent" triage agent that continuously mines explicit signals (resolved support tickets) and implicit signals (code-documentation discrepancies) to automatically detect and repair documentation drift in customer-facing documentation.
